name: email-draft-save
description: Save an email as a draft without sending it. The CEO can review and send the draft from their email client. Use when composing a reply that needs CEO approval before sending.

inputs.subject: string (email subject line)
inputs.body: string (email body; markdown supported, converted to HTML automatically)
inputs.account: string? (named account to draft from, as configured in channel_accounts.email. Defaults to the primary account.)
inputs.reply_to_message_id: string? (Nylas message ID to reply to; threads the draft as a reply when set)
inputs.attachments: object[]? (file attachments — array of {file_url: string, filename: string, content_type: string, node_id?: string}. file_url must be a file:// URL from email-download-attachment or similar. When the attachment contains KG-sourced data, set node_id to the kg_nodes UUID so export gates can resolve sensitivity. Max 10 attachments, 20 MB total.)
inputs.export_items: object[]? (parallel to attachments — array of {node_id: string, label: string} tagging each attachment's KG source for bulk-export gates.)
